rationale: Frequency droop gives P values of 2.52, 1.44, and -0.72 MW, all within charge/discharge limits. Voltage droop gives Q values of 1.05, 0.54, and -0.54 Mvar, all within the post-P apparent-power capability. SOC is updated for three 10-second intervals using discharge efficiency for positive P and charge efficiency for negative P.
